## stays-tampa-outer: hotels outside central Tampa (Westshore, North Tampa, East Tampa, Around the Bay)

**138 stays**, all checked 2026-09-27, all `status: open`.

### What is covered
- westshore 43 (Westshore district, airport incl. Tampa Airport Marriott, Rocky Point/Courtney Campbell, Town 'n' Country, Drew Park/stadium edge)
- north-tampa 17 (Busch Gardens/USF, Fletcher/I-75, New Tampa/Tampa Palms, Citrus Park, W Waters Ave)
- temple-terrace 7 (Telecom Park and Morris Bridge Road hotels east of I-75)
- east-tampa 10 (Seminole Hard Rock, fairgrounds/casino cluster, N 50th St, E 18th Ave)
- brandon 24 (Sabal Park, Palm River Rd, Falkenburg Rd, Adamo Dr, Riverview, Seffner)
- apollo-beach 4 (Ruskin, Sun City Center, Gibsonton; no hotel found in Apollo Beach proper)
- plant-city 5
- lutz-wesley-chapel 18 (Lutz, Land O' Lakes, Odessa, Wesley Chapel incl. Saddlebrook, Zephyrhills, Dade City)
- west-pasco 10 (New Port Richey, Port Richey, Holiday, Trinity, Hudson)

By kind: hotel 99, extended-stay 29, inn 3, boutique-hotel 2 (Hotel Alba, The CURRENT), condo-hotel 1 (Sailport), casino-resort 1 (Seminole Hard Rock Hotel & Casino Tampa), resort 1 (Saddlebrook), bed-and-breakfast 1 (Emberwood Manor), historic-hotel 1 (The Hacienda, New Port Richey, with a heritage block: NRHP #96001185, listed 1996).
By brand: Marriott 35, Hilton 35, IHG 17, Choice 14, Wyndham 10, Extended Stay America 7, Hyatt 5, Radisson 3, Red Roof 1, Hard Rock 1, Drury 1, Best Western 1, independents 8.
Fields: 137 with coordinates (Census address matches; Photon/OSM name matches for 6), 129 with room counts, 109 with an official url, 103 with a phone, 84 with a verbatim quote.

### How candidates were found (independent routes)
1. Visit Tampa Bay stay listings through the site's own listings API (catid 5, 105 listings): every listing in the regions Westshore/Airport, North Tampa and East Hillsborough (about 60 hotels); each listing page was read for address, phone, hotel-supplied description and amenity table.
2. Florida's Sports Coast (Pasco County tourism) accommodation listings through its WordPress API (31 listings: hotels, inns, B&Bs, RV parks).
3. The Cvent venue sitemap (~354,000 venue URLs) filtered to hotel/resort/boutique pages in every city in scope (Tampa, Temple Terrace, Brandon, Riverview, Seffner, Gibsonton, Ruskin, Sun City Center, Plant City, Lutz, Land O' Lakes, Wesley Chapel, Zephyrhills, Dade City, Odessa, Trinity, New Port Richey, Port Richey, Holiday, Hudson); about 210 profiles fetched and parsed.
4. Brand sitemaps as brand locators: Marriott (us-sitemap-hws), Hilton (prop-dt) and Wyndham (property sitemaps). Every Marriott and Hilton hotel in these areas in the brand's own sitemap is in the slice (35 each), with the exact brand URL. Wyndham pages were fetched; 8 sitemap entries (Wingate New Tampa and USF, Baymont Fairgrounds, HoJo Busch Gardens, Ramada Bayside NPR, Ramada Zephyrhills, Microtel Tampa Stadium, Travelodge Port Richey) now redirect to search results and were dropped.
5. OpenStreetMap (Photon) sweeps of tourism=hotel/motel/guest_house in eight bounding boxes, to find independents and to cross-check Cvent-only hotels (noted per record).
6. Plant City Chamber of Commerce hotel directory; own sites of Saddlebrook, Seminole Hard Rock, Sailport (Provident Resorts page), Oasis Bay Suites, The Westshore Grand, Drury, The Hacienda, Inn on the Gulf, The Locke Inn and Emberwood Manor.
(The session's WebSearch budget ran out early, so discovery relied on these lists rather than open web searches.)

### Sources and a limitation the verifier must know
The brand sites (marriott.com, hilton.com, ihg.com, hyatt.com, choicehotels.com, bestwestern.com, extendedstayamerica.com, radissonhotels.com, redroof.com) return 403 or time out to both curl and WebFetch here, so no brand page was read. `url` holds the brand page (from the brand sitemap or the listing's website field); facts come from `source_url`: the Visit Tampa Bay listing for 62 hotels (hotel-supplied text and amenity table), the Cvent profile for 37 (hotel-maintained), the Florida's Sports Coast listing for 20, a Wyndham page for 7, the Plant City Chamber directory for 3, and the hotel's own site for the rest. Other pages read are in `also_sources`; `notes` say which fact came from which page.
- Features come only from those pages: Visit Tampa Bay amenity tables (Pool, Fitness, Pets Allowed, airport shuttle, Complimentary Daily Breakfast, restaurants >= 1, meeting rooms >= 1, Kitchenette, EV charging, Spa, Golf; all-suites when suites = rooms), Cvent checkboxes (pool, fitness, pet-friendly; airport shuttle only when there is no Visit Tampa Bay listing; restaurant only for Holiday Inn, Hilton Garden Inn and Cambria; never spa), and description text (waterfront, bay-view, rooftop-bar, free-parking, kitchens, beachfront).
- Rooms: the main source's number; disagreements are in notes (Westin 252 vs 254, The CURRENT 180 vs 178, Saddlebrook 450 vs 451, Holiday Inn Tampa North 83 vs 86). Null where there is no basis to choose (Aloft/Element share a building; Sailport 147 vs 140; Hampton Dade City 64 vs 68).
- `opened` only where a page says so (Saddlebrook 1981, The Hacienda 1927, Inn on the Gulf 1998). Cvent's "Built" year is never used as an opening year; summaries say "built in ... according to its Cvent profile".
- Quotes were checked by script to be verbatim substrings of the quoted page (whitespace normalized), all 40 words or fewer.

### Area decisions
- Hotels whose names say Brandon (Palm River Rd, Falkenburg Rd, Sabal Park/Princess Palm Ave, Adamo Dr, Causeway Blvd) are `brandon` even with a Tampa 33610/33619 address; hotels branded Fairgrounds/Casino or on Orient Rd, US 301, E MLK Blvd, E Sligh Ave, N 50th St and E 18th Ave are `east-tampa`.
- `temple-terrace`: Temple Terrace addresses plus the Telecom Park/Morris Bridge Road hotels east of I-75 (Ramada Temple Terrace, Fairfield Tampa North, Residence Inn USF). Courtyard Fletcher, Hampton Tampa North and Holiday Inn Express Telecom Drive stay in `north-tampa` (Tampa addresses).
- Town 'n' Country and airport-north hotels are `westshore`; Citrus Park (Courtyard Veterans Expressway) and W Waters Ave (La Quinta Tampa Central) are `north-tampa`.
- Hampton Inn Odessa Trinity is `lutz-wesley-chapel` (Odessa per SPEC); Holiday Inn Express Trinity is `west-pasco`.
- Possible overlap with stays-tampa-core: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Tampa Stadium Area (2055 N Dale Mabry; Visit Tampa Bay files it under Westshore/Airport) and Country Inn & Suites Tampa RJ Stadium (4750 N Dale Mabry) are here as `westshore`.

### Deliberately left out
- Economy motels not on any official tourism list: Rodeway (6), Econo Lodge (3), Red Roof Inn/Red Roof PLUS (3), Days Inn (4), Motel 6, Knights Inn, Masters Inn, Magnuson/Roadstar Zephyrhills, Clarion Pointe Brandon, Suburban Studios, Vista Inn, Ruskin Inn, Belmont Inn, Green Key Beach Motel and independent motels on Busch Blvd, US 92 and US 19. (Microtel Zephyrhills and Quality Inn Zephyrhills are in because Pasco's tourism office lists them.)
- InTown Suites, Uptown Suites Riverview, Stay Sojo (weekly-rate workforce housing).
- Campgrounds and RV resorts (Bay Bayou, Key Lime Bay, Winter Quarters Pasco, Quail Run, Orchid Lake, Majestic Oaks): the outdoors slice owns campgrounds. Clothing-optional resorts in Lutz/Land O' Lakes (Paradise Lakes, Lake Como, Caliente): not researched.

- Conflicting or unconfirmed: 2450 S Falkenburg Rd (Cvent: Extended Stay America Tampa Brandon East; OSM: WoodSpring Suites); 9331 E Adamo Dr (Cvent: Quality Inn & Conference Center Tampa-Brandon; OSM: Clarion Inn); Extended Stay America Suites Tampa NE (12162 Morris Bridge Rd, Cvent only, no room data); Spot X Hotel Wesley Chapel (Cvent only); Ramada Tampa Westshore Airport South (Cvent only, not in Wyndham's sitemap); OSM-only West Wing Hotel (2501 E Fowler Ave), Clarion Hotel & Conference Center (2701 E Fowler Ave), Country Inn & Suites Seffner (11551 Discovery Lane), Extended Stay America Tampa Airport Memorial Highway (4811 Memorial Hwy), Extended Stay America at 6780 Corporex Park Dr; Pirate's Pointe Fishing Resort, Ruskin (Cvent only).
- The Godfrey Hotel & Cabanas Tampa (7700 W Courtney Campbell Cswy, still in OSM): godfreyhotels.com no longer lists Tampa and the old domains do not resolve; status unknown, left out. Chase Suite Hotel (Rocky Point): its domain is for sale; left out.
- Home2 Suites Riverview: no geocoder match for 9903 Alafia Preserve Ave, so it has no coordinates.

### Open questions for the verifier
1. Hurricane Helene (Sep 2024) flooded the Hudson coast. The Inn on the Gulf and Hudson Dockside Inn pages do not mention damage or closure (Inn on the Gulf's site is current, with reservations and a 2026 copyright; Hudson Dockside Inn's site shows only navigation text). Please confirm both operate. The Rocky Point waterfront hotels show no closure; the Grand Hyatt listing says its boardwalk and nature trail are under repairs.
2. Cvent-only hotels (IHG, Choice, ESA, Radisson, Best Western without a Visit Tampa Bay listing) were cross-checked against OpenStreetMap; Extended Stay America Tampa Brandon and WoodSpring Suites Tampa Airport North have no second source; Quality Inn Plant City-Lakeland appears in OSM as a Comfort Inn.
3. Drury Plaza Hotel Tampa Brandon is new ("Now Open" on its page; Visit Tampa Bay said reservations from May 29); no opening year is stated.
4. Saddlebrook describes a $92 million renovation; it is open and booking, so status is open. Ramada Temple Terrace shows a renovation notice "until further notice"; status open.
5. Address conflicts noted in records: The Hacienda zip (34652 Cvent vs 34656 Florida's Sports Coast), Hampton Inn Odessa Trinity street number (11780 Cvent/OSM vs 11789 listing), Holiday Inn Express Ruskin (Cvent zip 33701 is wrong; left null), Hampton Inn Plant City (2702 chamber vs 2707 OSM).

## Verification (2026-09-27)

Adversarial re-check of all **138** records by a second agent. The slice now has **141 stays**: 138 checked, 0 removed, 3 added.

### How it was checked
- **Every source page was re-read.** All 253 `source_url` and `also_sources` pages were downloaded again today. curl with a browser user agent reads Visit Tampa Bay, Cvent, Florida's Sports Coast, Wyndham and the hotels' own sites. Each page was reduced to its listing text: the About text plus amenity table, Cvent's About, venue details, amenities and FAQ, or the own-site copy.
- **Scripted checks** ran on every record:
  - Each `quote` is a verbatim substring of its page. All pass, and all are 40 words or fewer.
  - The phone digits, street number, zip and room count appear on the source or an also-source.
  - Each feature has keyword evidence in the extracted listing text.
- **Summaries were read by hand.** Every summary was compared claim by claim with the extracted text.
- **Coordinates.** Every record was looked up by name in OpenStreetMap (Photon). Targeted queries covered the 35 with no first match. Every point in Westshore, North Tampa, Temple Terrace, East Tampa and Brandon was also run through the Census geographies service to find its municipality or CDP.
- **Limits of this check:**
  - The session's WebSearch budget (200) was already used up before this verifier started. Bing and DuckDuckGo return captchas or unrelated results to curl.
  - Brand sites still return 403: Marriott, Hilton, IHG, Hyatt, Choice, Best Western, ESA and Radisson.
  - So closure and rebrand checks rest on four things: the pages themselves, the brand sitemaps (Hilton, Marriott, Wyndham), the full Cvent venue sitemap (re-downloaded, 354,678 URLs) and OpenStreetMap.
